input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 is mutual in form and excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually, and the Section 8 infringement indemnity is carved out (which benefits us). However it fails the fallback on two material terms. First, the cap is not 12 months' fees: it is limited to amounts actually paid by Corio "for the transaction which the liability relates to" in the preceding 12 months, which slices the cap down to a single transaction's fees and can easily fall below six months' fees — walk-away territory for a vendor cap. Second, the only carve-out is Section 8; there is no carve-out for breach of the confidentiality obligations (Section 10 / the concurrent NDA) or for gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, whereas the fallback requires carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct. The redline keeps the existing sentence structure, restores a true twelve-month fee cap with the USD 1,000,000 floor, and defines "Excluded Claims" to preserve the Section 8 carve-out while adding confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud for both parties.

proposal.summary: Make the Section 9 cap a true 12-month fee cap (greater of 12 months' fees or US$1,000,000) and add mutual carve-outs for confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud alongside the existing Section 8 carve-out.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap a genuine twelve-month fee cap (greater of fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months or US$1,000,000) rather than one limited to the single "transaction" at issue, which could fall well below six months' fees. We have also carried the existing Section 8 carve-out into a defined set of Excluded Claims so that indemnification, confidentiality breaches and gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud sit outside the cap for both parties.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT

ops.oldText: EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL AMOUNT PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE LIABILITY AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000).

ops.oldText: THE PARTIES AGREE THAT THIS SECTION 9 REPRESENTS A REASONABLE ALLOCATION OF RISK.
ops.newText: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD. THE PARTIES AGREE THAT THIS SECTION 9 REPRESENTS A REASONABLE ALLOCATION OF RISK.
